Callout.Name: Suspected Stroke
Callout.Message: Person with slurred speech and a weak side.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, family present, onset twenty minutes ago.

Script.Line: It came on while I was on the phone. The words just went.
My face feels wrong on this side. I can feel it drooping.
What time is it? Somebody write down what time it is.

Callout.Patient: My arm went heavy. I could not hold the phone.

Lines.Approach: Face dropped and one side weak, twenty minutes ago. That is a stroke clock and it is running.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
